description: Form for adding new SKU products. Accepts three parameters: sku, name, and description. POST requests trigger database operations with SQLite.
notes: CRITICAL FINDING: POST requests without required parameters trigger PHP error messages revealing database path (/var/www/html/sku_add.php:11) and SQLite constraints. Errors show 'SQLSTATE[23000]: Integrity constraint violation: 19 NOT NULL constraint failed: skus.sku'. Form uses POST method with three fields. File path disclosure vulnerability. No CSRF token observed.
